newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka proposes to offer citizenship for $25,000.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka proposes to offer citizenship for $25,000.

text.p: Foreign investors and professionals who have lived in Sri Lanka for five years will be able to buy Sri Lankan citizenship for $25,000 under new regulations introduced by the government in parliament on Wednesday.

Deputy Defence Ministry Anuruddha Ratwatte told parliament that "a reasonable number" of people registered under the Resident Guest Scheme were eligible to apply for citizenship after residing in the Indian Ocean island for five years.

The scheme, administered by the Finance Ministry and the Board of Investment, provides for the Defence Minister to grant citizenship to foreigners who would contribute to the economic, social and cultural enrichment of Sri Lanka, he said.
Ratwatte did not say how many people were eligible for citizenship under the proposed scheme.
The new rules prescribe a fee of $25,000 for the main applicant and $10,000 for spouses and each dependent child, he said.
